message.artistry.too_many_editors: Too many players are editing this poster
screen.artistry.config.server_controlled: Server options are set by the server
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.artistry: Create your own paintings with images together with your friends!
option.artistry.poster_view_distance.too: How far away posters keep rendering. Lower values help performance where posters are dense. Sodium-based mods may cap this with their own block entity culling.
option.artistry.max_editors.tooltip: How many players may keep the same poster open at once. 0 removes the limit.
option.artistry.disable_images.tooltip: Blocks uploading and placing images on canvases. Drawing by hand stays available.
option.artistry.batch_interval.tooltip: How often accumulated brush strokes are sent to the server. Higher values save traffic but make other players' drawing look choppy.
option.artistry.cursor_interval.tooltip: How often your cursor position is sent to other players editing the same canvas.
option.artistry.world_sync_interval.tool: How often canvases refresh for players looking at them in the world instead of editing. Never more often than the draw batch interval.
option.artistry.image_bandwidth.tooltip: Upload speed limit per player for images. Lower values spare the server on a weak connection, but large images take longer.
message.artistry.image_rate_limited: Image upload limit reached, try again in a moment
